facts.text: The hotel opened in 1890 at the base of Higashiyama.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Miyako Kyoto opened in 1890 at the base of Higashiyama in the ancient capital city of Kyoto, Japan.

facts.text: The hotel is in eastern Kyoto at the edge of the Higashiyama mountain range, with numerous UNESCO heritage sites within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Miyako Kyoto is located in the traditional district of eastern Kyoto, at the edge of the Higashiyama mountain range with numerous UNESCO heritage sites in walking distance.

facts.text: Nearby temples and shrines include the Heian Shrine, Nanzenji, Eikando and Ginkakuji.
facts.excerpt: Nearby explore museums, music halls, zoos, historical temples and shrines, including the Nanzenji, Heian Shrine, Eikando and Ginkakuji.

facts.text: The Kasui-en annex was designed by architect Togo Murano in 1959 and is hailed as a masterpiece of modernist Japanese architecture.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s outstanding annex, hailed as a masterpiece of modernist Japanese architecture, was designed by celebrated architect Togo Murano in 1959.

facts.text: Kyoto Keage Onsen hot spring water flows from the ground beneath the hotel, feeding indoor and semi-open-air onsen baths for men and women.
facts.excerpt: “Kyoto Keage Onsen” flows from the ground beneath the hotel; these waters enhance recovery from fatigue and coldness. Our indoor and semi-open-air Onsen baths are accessible to both men and women.

facts.text: Spa KACHO's semi-open-air bath looks out on the hotel's garden leading to Mount Kacho.
facts.excerpt: Semi open-air bath that blends in breath-taking views of the hotel’s garden leading to Mt. Kacho

facts.text: Spa KACHO's design was inspired by the brick, moss-covered Suirokaku aqueduct at Nanzenji Temple.
facts.excerpt: the design of Spa KACHO was inspired by the brick and moss-covered Suirokaku aqueduct, built on the grounds of nearby Nanzenji Temple in 1889.

facts.text: Le Jardin Sothys offers programs including hot spring baths, traditional Japanese massage, acupressure, moxibustion and meditation.
facts.excerpt: help you select a healing program that includes hot spring baths, traditional Japanese massages, acupressure, moxibustion, and meditation.

facts.text: A trail near the hotel climbs toward the Ohyakuinari Shrine through a forest that is home to over 50 species of wild birds.
facts.excerpt: wander the trail near our Kyoto spa hotel, which ascends toward the Ohyakuinari Shrine and Jizo relics, and enjoy the peace and tranquility of a serene green forest that is a natural habitat for over 50 species of wild birds.

facts.text: The hotel arranges experiences such as hotel tours, sake tasting and kimono fittings.
facts.excerpt: including hotel tours, sake tasting, kimono fittings, and more.

facts.text: Rooms use soft curving forms and wood floors and walls, with carpets inspired by Kyoto's kawadoko river-floor summer dining.
facts.excerpt: Soft curvilinear forms and the use of wood on floors and walls, along with carpets inspired by Kyoto's summer dining traditions of kawadoko or “river floor”, create serene spaces

facts.text: The Westin Club lounge serves coffee, tea and other drinks, with a cocktail hour at the end of the day.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy coffee, tea, and other beverages or a cocktail hour at the end of the day.

facts.text: Dominique Bouchet, who earned a Michelin star in Tokyo, supervises the French restaurant, which pairs its dishes with 300 varieties of wine.
facts.excerpt: Supervised by Dominique Bouchet, who earned one Michelin star in Tokyo, Chef Sako delivers authentic French cuisine at this restaurant in Higashiyama, Kyoto. Savor sauces praised as "profoundly flavorful yet light," paired with 300 varieties of wine.

facts.text: RAQOU, the all-day restaurant, overlooks Higashiyama and the city of Kyoto.
facts.excerpt: RAQOU, the hotel’s smart-casual all day dining restaurant that overlooks the picturesque natural surroundings of Higashiyama and the city of Kyoto.
No, pets are not allowed at The Westin Miyako Kyoto.

facts.text: The closest airport is Osaka International Airport (Itami), about 60 kilometers away.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The Westin Miyako Kyoto is Osaka International Airport - Itami (ITM). ITM is located approximately 60.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel has a satellite concierge baggage counter at Kyoto Station for guests.
facts.excerpt: Satellite ConciergeKyoto Station baggage storage service counter for hotel guests.
